core_obligations: For a point x' of the normalization above x, use dimension theory to see that the local ring there is again one dimensional, and normality to conclude it is a discrete valuation ring, hence a regular local k-algebra with separable residue field (proof lines 5114-5119).

Apply the formal smoothness criterion for regular local algebras with separable residue field, and the theorem identifying formal smoothness with geometric regularity, to conclude that the normalization is geometrically regular at x' (proof lines 5120-5128).

Use reducedness of the local ring at x to see that the family of maps from that local ring into the geometrically reduced local rings upstairs is injective, conclude that the local ring at x is a geometrically reduced k-algebra, and read off geometric reducedness of X at x (proof lines 5130-5136).
proof_roadmap: Local structure of the normalization at a point above x (proof lines 5114-5119).
Formal smoothness gives geometric regularity upstairs (proof lines 5120-5128).
Injectivity of the local maps gives geometric reducedness downstairs (proof lines 5130-5136).
difficulty_reason: For a locally algebraic k-scheme X with normalization nu, and a point x whose local ring is reduced of dimension one and over which all residue fields of the normalization are separable over k, the lemma concludes that X is geometrically reduced at x and the normalization is geometrically regular at every point above x (statement lines 5101-5110). The proof first pins down the local structure upstairs: the local ring of the normalization at a point over x is again one dimensional by dimension theory, and being normal it is a discrete valuation ring, hence a regular local k-algebra with separable residue field; the author then invokes the formal smoothness criterion for regular local algebras with separable residue field and the theorem identifying formal smoothness with geometric regularity to conclude geometric regularity upstairs (proof lines 5112-5128). The second half transfers reducedness downward: injectivity of the local map from the reduced local ring at x into the geometrically reduced local ring upstairs forces the local ring at x to be geometrically reduced, and the pointwise criterion lifts that to geometric reducedness of X at x (proof lines 5130-5136). The claim is H3: the argument couples dimension theory, the discrete valuation ring structure of the normalization, formal smoothness over the residue field and the descent of geometric reducedness along an injective local map, none of which is a single citation.
